CategoryEntity TypeDescriptionExample
Basic Accident InformationAccident NameOfficial or commonly used name of a coal mine accidentSunjiawan Gas Explosion Accident
Accident TypeClassification of accidents according to standardsGas-related accidents
Accident LevelSeverity level defined by regulationsMajor accident
Accident TimeOccurrence time of the accident2005-02-14 09:30:00
Spatial InformationMine LocationSpecific mine where the accident occurredSunjiawan Coal Mine
Geographic LocationAdministrative or geographic region of the accidentLiaoning Province
Causation & ConsequenceAccident CauseDirect or indirect causes leading to the accidentGas accumulation
Risk FactorLatent hazardous conditions increasing accident probabilityInadequate ventilation
Accident ConsequenceLosses or impacts caused by the accidentCasualties, economic loss
Responsibility & PreventionOrganization & Personnel (O&P)Organizations or individuals responsible or involvedMine operator, safety officer
Laws & Regulations (L&R)Legal or regulatory documents related to safety complianceCoal Mine Safety Regulation
Prevention StrategyMeasures aimed at preventing similar accidentsGas monitoring enhancement
Facilities & EquipmentFacilities & Equipment (F&E)Physical equipment or facilities involved in the accidentVentilation system, gas sensor

Relation TypeSubject → ObjectSemantic MeaningExample
BelongsToAccident Name → Type/Level; Mine Location → Geographic LocationIndicates membership or affiliation(Sunjiawan Gas Explosion Accident, BelongsTo, Gas-related accidents)
OccurredAccident Name → Location/TimeSpatiotemporal occurrence of an accident(Sunjiawan Gas Explosion Accident, Occurred, Sunjiawan Coal Mine)
CausesAccident Name → Consequence; Causes → Accident Name; Risk Factor → CausesCausal relationship between entities(Gas accumulation, Causes, Sunjiawan Gas Explosion Accident)
BearsO&P → Accident NameResponsibility attribution(Operator, Bears, Sunjiawan Gas Explosion Accident)
ViolatesO&P → L&RViolation of safety regulations(Operator, Violates, Safety regulation)
TakesO&P → Prevention StrategyImplementation of preventive actions(Mine, Takes, Ventilation improvement)
InvolvesAccident Name → F&E/O&PEntities involved in the accident(Sunjiawan Gas Explosion Accident, Involves, Gas sensor)
AssociatedWithF&E → Risk FactorIndicates an association(Gas sensor, AssociatedWith, Sensor failure)
